prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production transparent sprite sheet for a layered native desktop pixel-art companion RESEARCH.
Reference image 1: the existing RESEARCH sheet is the identity and costume reference. Reference image 2: green-haired adult researcher, third heroine, is the canonical proportions and material shading reference. Draw ONLY this same one adult researcher eight times, no other characters.
Primary request: eight additional DISTINCT full-body work and movement drawings, arranged exactly 4 columns by 2 rows, evenly sized generous cells. Same adult woman in all cells: mint green wavy bob, black round glasses, golden earrings, dark teal belted short dress, beige botanical-pattern long cardigan, semiopaque black tights, dark brown ankle boots, brown side satchel. Preserve her identity and attractive adult body proportions. Detailed crisp pixel art with dimensional fabric shading, face fully intact and normal hand anatomy. Direction lighting consistent.
Transparent RGBA backdrop, genuinely transparent, NO floor, NO colored outlines or colored matte fringe, no glows, no red/yellow/green halos. Each complete silhouette has substantial transparent padding on ALL sides including tops, hands and toes. Never crop any hair, finger, bag, stool or furniture. NO lettering, labels, separators, border or watermark.
TOP row left to right:
1 right-facing three-quarter standing work view, holding and reading an open book, right-side face visibly different from left views.
2 exact right-facing profile working with book at chest height, genuine profile silhouette and glasses seen from side.
3 entirely back-facing standing work view, cardigan back and haircut drawn, holding book in front of her; face NOT visible.
4 walking left with purposeful gait, one foot forward, book closed tucked under arm.
BOTTOM row left to right:
5 walking right, opposite leg forward, the motion must be a newly drawn anatomy view not a mirrored identical sprite.
6 kneeling on ONE knee researching an open book in hands, face looking down carefully.
7 leaning forward with one forearm on a narrow minimal work desk, reading open book, legs and boots complete.
8 seated at a minimal compact desk reading and annotating a book with a pencil, stool and desk complete, natural seated anatomy.
Keep a consistent physical head/body scale across the views. Poses with furniture can occupy more width but retain the same head size. All 8 figures and furniture separated with wide transparent gutters; all 8 complete. No repeated neutral standing pose except specified working viewpoints.
